name: Timeindexedpartof Pattern
description:
The time indexed part of pattern. 
This pattern re-uses part of and time-indexed situation patterns. It is extracted from DOLCE-UltraLite by partial clone of elements.
competency_questions: Which parts did a given object have during a particular period?; Over which stretch of time was one object a part of another?; Has a given part belonged to more than one whole over time, and during which period did it belong to each?
competency_questions_source: derived from the pattern's own axioms during the OntoBoard review and checked against them; the upstream submission states none
